name: Joe's iOS Builds
subtitle: OpenNOW, VoidLink, and ChargeLens personal builds

apps.name: OpenNOW Debug
apps.localizedDescription: Adds independent Frame Generation Quality: Performance / Native in Settings and live Picture controls. Performance reduces generated-frame processing size for 8-bit 4:2:0; real frames and host stream settings stay unchanged. Native retains full-size interpolation. Generated/displayed FPS and safeguards retained. Mac SDR/PQ GPU checks passed; iPhone performance needs testing. Unsigned build, 184 tests passed, zero failed, one simulator skip.

apps.name: VoidLink PyroWave
apps.localizedDescription: VoidLink contributors; local PyroWave build with mouse and desktop scaling changes.

apps.name: ChargeLens
apps.localizedDescription: Personal charging sensor app for iPhone 18 Pro Max / iOS 27 (requires iOS 26+). Live USB-C input watts, volts and amps, separate battery charging watts, graphs, saved sessions and CSV export. Reads private hardware sensors; no watt estimates from battery percentage. Wireless input watts may be unavailable. 25 simulator tests passed; physical-phone sensor access and accuracy still need verification. Unsigned IPA for installer signing.
